experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.asm: vfdiv.d $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vfdiv.d $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vpickve2gr.d $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 2000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'vfdiv.d $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vfdiv.d $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vpickve2gr.d $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4'

latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency. Chain: tested op, then vpickve2gr.d+and+or+vreplgr2vr.d to restore the input pattern; the 7-cycle closure is subtracted (calibrated with vadd.b/xvadd.b). Swept 26 operand values including 0, powers of two, max, minnorm, maxsub, minsub, Inf and NaN: latency 8-11 cycles, CPI 4.4988-6. The stored experiment uses 1.0. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vfdiv.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vfdiv.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vfdiv.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vfdiv.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vfdiv.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vfdiv.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vfdiv.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vfdiv.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vfdiv.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vfdiv.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vfdiv.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vfdiv.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vfdiv.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vfdiv.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vfdiv.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vfdiv.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput, 8 independent lanes. CPI ranges 4.4988-6 over the same 26-value sweep; the stored experiment uses 1.0.

notes: Latency model: 8 cycles for special operands, 10 when the divisor is a power of two (the stored sample uses 1.0/1.0), 23 for a general divisor, up to +1 with a subnormal operand. The stored experiment runs the division twice, so cycles = (core_cycles - 7) / 2. 64-bit vector lanes match the scalar numbers and run in parallel (slowest lane dominates); 32-bit vector lanes cost 2 x scalar - 5.
